title: test(cli): pin the Setup Integrations merged order to each contributor's priority
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao7HnHZJorpia6QZ5CZ4pABw)_

Fixes #28260

Refs #27238

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增一个测试,钉住 Setup → Integrations 分组里五个入口的顺序(Webhooks/Datasources → Connect an Agent → Connector Credentials → Cloud Connection),顺序从各插件真实的 `priority` 读出;另在真实运行的服务上走通了「安装应用 → 缺凭据 → 跳过 → 去凭据页填写 → 连接器无需重启即就绪」的全过程,记录贴在卡上。
- **为什么改**:#28200 的契约复审留了两条应修项:S1 要求在真实环境证明凭据闭环,S2 要求防止以后有人改一个数字就悄悄打乱管理员看到的菜单顺序。
- **风险与回滚**:只加一个测试文件,不动任何产品代码,不发布任何包;回滚即删除该文件。
- **先看**:`packages/cli/test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts`(顺序断言与优先级读取两段)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts`,预期 1 passed;把 Connect an Agent 与 Connector Credentials 的 priority 对调后重建,同一命令变红。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One new test file, `packages/cli/test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts` (S2 of the contract review on #28200). It composes the real Setup app shell and the five packages that contribute into `group_integrations`, folds them through the real `SchemaRegistry`, and asserts:

- the merged order, tier by tier: `nav_webhooks` / `nav_http_deliveries` / `nav_datasources` (one priority, compared as a set because the fold's stable sort leaves that tie to registration order), then `nav_connect_agent`, then `nav_connector_credentials`, then `nav_cloud_connection`;
- the priorities behind that order, **read from the contributions themselves** (no priority literal appears in the test): each tier shares one priority and every tier sorts strictly before the next, with the failure message naming the package that declares each side;
- that nothing else contributes into the group, so a new entry is a deliberate edit of this pin.

`@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` and `@objectstack/service-datasource` register their contribution from `init()`, so they are booted on a context serving only the `manifest` service, the same way `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` boots them. The file uses `SchemaRegistry` directly (no `new ObjectQL(`), so it classifies into the `unit` tier.

S1 (the live round trip) changes no file. Its record is posted on #28260.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` at `98931dde`: 3 files, 25 tests passed.
- Ablation (one-time, not kept): swapped the two priorities in source (`connector-credentials-ui.ts` 120 to 110, `connect-ui.ts` 110 to 120) with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, rebuilt both packages, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` saw both markers in `dist/`, and the pin went red on the tier assertion (`expected Set{ 'nav_connector_credentials' } to deeply equal Set{ 'nav_connect_agent' }`). Restore proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), both packages rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean, pin green again.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` at `98931dde`: 358 files, 5136 tests passed. The `integration` tier is declared to CI (the diff touches no integration-tier file or spawn entry).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **S1 ran on a probe package, not on HotCRM.** HotCRM declares no connector at all: `git grep -il credentialRef origin/main` over `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `a598256` returns nothing, and its own `content/docs/guides/integrations.mdx` says "`src/` carries no connector metadata of any kind". The Slack connector the decision card #27230 cites is a roadmap line in that page, so installing HotCRM would list no reference. The probe package (`com.example.slackprobe`) declares one `rest` connector whose bearer token is `credentialRef: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`.
- **The marketplace catalog was a local stand-in.** This container's proxy refuses `cloud.objectos.ai` and `marketplace.objectos.ai` (CONNECT 403), so the dev stack read its catalog through `OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` pointed at a local server serving the snapshot shape (`packages.json`, `packages/ID.json`, `packages/ID/versions/latest/manifest.json`). Everything after that (the Console package page, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, the credential step, the Setup page, the credential door, the automation service) is the real stack.
- The live Setup sidebar served the Integrations group in exactly the order this pin holds: Webhooks, HTTP Deliveries, Datasources, Connect an Agent, Connector Credentials, Cloud Connection.
- Observation, not filed: the Connector Credentials page's "Last changed" column shows the raw user id (`… by aPIvyNcbsR4QACN8KHZlCylmhRIImV7v`) rather than a name. carrier: none.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates: 48 derived, 48 run, all exit 0 (reconciled at 98931dde)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran …`: "48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first answered exit 3 (its fixture commit absent from the shallow clone); after `git fetch origin 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4 --depth=1` it passed (48 cases). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. The record is `28260-gates-ran-98931dde.list` in the seat's out folder.

</details>

<details><summary>S1 live round trip (summary; the full record is on #28260)</summary>

`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38517` (showcase), no connector env var set (`SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` unset), catalog stand-in on 38518. Install from the Console package page: `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` `{"packageId":"slack_probe"}` answered 200 with `credentialRefs: [{ref: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, status: missing}]`; the step listed `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN · slack_probe_api`; Skip showed "Skipped for now" with a link to `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/connector-credentials`; on that page `PUT …/credential-refs/SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` answered `status: set, source: object` with the connector `state: ready`; `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors` lists `slack_probe_api` `ready` with action `request`. Server pid 15400 before and after. The value appeared in no response body, no DOM text, no input after save, no reloaded page and no server log line.

</details>
